documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Approval Of Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone And Consolidated) For The Quarter And Half-Year Ended September 30, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Emcure Pharmaceuticals reported its investor presentation for September 2026, showcasing strong financial and operational performance for FY26 with operating revenue exceeding USD 1 billion and solid growth across both domestic and international segments. Management highlighted strategic priorities around expanding their domestic chronic franchise, scaling international markets in Europe, Canada, and the Rest of World, and advancing differentiated R&D platforms such as complex injectables and biologics. The company also emphasized ongoing sustainability initiatives, including increased renewable energy adoption, alongside experienced board leadership guiding execution. Emcure Pharmaceuticals reported strong Q1 FY27 results, with total revenue growing by 22.8% year-on-year to INR 2,580 crore and EBITDA increasing by 25.8% to INR 508 crore. Management highlighted a solid performance in international markets and a return to double-digit growth in the domestic business following the stabilization and consolidation of Zuventus.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver low to mid-teen revenue growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: I would like to reiterate my confidence in Emcure to deliver low to mid-teen revenue growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: Full-year R&D expenses are projected to be between 4% and 5% of revenue.
guidance.quote: R&D, I for the full year will be between that 4% to 5% range.

guidance.claim: The net debt is expected to increase next quarter due to completed payouts for Mantra and Gennova.
guidance.quote: Net debt is expected to increase in the next quarter, reflecting the Mantra and Gennova payouts completed in July.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates becoming net cash by the end of FY28.
guidance.quote: Probably by the end of FY28, we should be net cash.

guidance.claim: Management expects continued growth over the full year as the strengthened team and portfolio gain traction.
guidance.quote: Expect continued growth over the full year as our strengthened team and portfolio gain traction

demand_outlook.claim: Management is confident of continued growth in the Indian business as sales teams and portfolio traction strengthen.
demand_outlook.quote: We remain confident of continued growth in India as we strengthen our sales teams and our portfolio continues to gain traction.

demand_outlook.claim: International markets delivered strong growth supported by base business ramp-up, new launches, and currency tailwinds.
demand_outlook.quote: The international business delivered very strong and robust growth during the quarter with revenue of INR 1,485 crore, a growth of 34.2%.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth in the Rest of the World region was led by robust performance in the ARV business.
demand_outlook.quote: Rest of the World grew by 44.8% to INR 522 crore, led by very strong performance in the ARV business.

demand_outlook.claim: Europe's growth was driven by a strong base business performance and enhanced contribution from liposomal amphotericin B.
demand_outlook.quote: Europe grew by 32.8% to INR 537 crore with growth led by a strong base business performance and enhanced contribution from liposomal amphotericin B.

demand_outlook.claim: International performance featured strong orderbook-led performance in RoW.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired a 12.05% minority stake in Gennova, making it a 100% owned subsidiary.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter that ended, we received 15-plus product approvals across developed and emerging markets.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin improved by 50 basis points to 19.7% due to productivity gains and operating leverage.
margins_costs.quote: Margin has improved to 19.7%, an expansion of 50 basis points reflecting productivity gains and operating leverage in this quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Gross debt as of June 30 stood at INR 1,291 crore, with cash and cash equivalents at INR 189 crore, leaving net debt at INR 1,103 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Gross debt as on 30th June stood at INR 1,291 crore with cash and cash equivalents at INR 189 crore. Net debt stood at INR 1,103 crore.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that significant uncertainties continue to persist globally, including in West Asia, the Middle East, Russia, and Ukraine.
risks_headwinds.quote: If you look at the global environment, what's happening in West Asia, Middle East or even for that matter, what's happening with Russia and Ukraine, there continues to be significant uncertainty

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to delivering low to mid-teen revenue growth.
management_commitments.quote: I would like to reiterate my confidence in Emcure to deliver low to mid-teen revenue growth in FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to reach a net cash position by the end of FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Probably by the end of FY28, we should be net cash.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects continued growth over the full year.
management_commitments.quote: Expect continued growth over the full year as our strengthened team and portfolio gain traction

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
